Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE*, J.K. MAHESHWARI
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016: s.9 – Initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) – Applicability of Limitation Act – Pursuant to agreement, respondent let out a crane on hire to the appellant – on the appellant between 03.01.2013 and 04.03.2013 for a sum of Rs.38,84,709/- – On 14.10.2013, Respondent issued statutory notice to Appellant-Company for its winding up for payment of invoices– Appellant replied to notice on 07.11.2013, acknowledging its liability to the Respondent
